title: luzula campestris subsp. multiflora
intro: Luzula campestris subsp. multiflora, commonly known as multiflorous woodrush, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The multiflorous woodrush is said to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
